$description: InputGroup (platform/components/InputGroup, library wave 6, lane A): its component tokens. The box is the Input’s field (its fill, border, corners and states point to the Input’s tokens, so a change to the field reaches the group); the affixes are muted text; attached controls are Buttons and Selects with their own tokens.

input-group-max-width.$description: InputGroup: the widest the group grows (the Input’s maximum width).

input-group-width-xs-width.$description: InputGroup width xs: the extra-small field width.

input-group-width-sm-width.$description: InputGroup width sm: the small field width.

input-group-width-md-width.$description: InputGroup width md: the medium field width.

input-group-width-lg-width.$description: InputGroup width lg: the large field width.

input-group-border-width.$description: InputGroup box: the field’s border width.

input-group-min-height.$description: InputGroup box: the field’s height (the standard control height).

input-group-padding-inline.$description: InputGroup: the space between the box’s edge and the prefix, the suffix or the icon (the field’s own inset).

input-group-hover-border-color.$description: InputGroup box: the border under the pointer.

input-group-focus-border-color.$description: InputGroup box: the border while the field has focus (border color only).

input-group-invalid-border-color.$description: InputGroup box: the border of an invalid field.

input-group-disabled-background.$description: InputGroup box: the fill of a disabled field.

input-group-disabled-text.$description: InputGroup: the affixes and the icon of a disabled field.

input-group-readonly-background.$description: InputGroup box: the fill of a read-only field.

input-group-affix-text.$description: InputGroup prefix and suffix: muted, so the value reads first.

input-group-affix-font-family.$description: InputGroup prefix and suffix: the field’s font.

input-group-data-font-family.$description: InputGroup data: the prefix and suffix in the data font (Reddit Mono), for technical values.

input-group-affix-font-size.$description: InputGroup prefix and suffix: the field’s text size.

input-group-affix-line-height.$description: InputGroup prefix and suffix: the field’s line height.

input-group-affix-gap.$description: InputGroup: the space between an affix (or the icon) and the value.

input-group-icon-color.$description: InputGroup icon: muted, as the affixes.

input-group-icon-size.$description: InputGroup icon: the standard control’s grid icon.

input-group-warning-border-color.$description: InputGroup: the border of a group with a warning.
